cases.text: Guardians… the City is lost… if there is any Light left in the system… we rally on Titan. Be brave.
Guardian Ship, this is Zavala. It's too late. The Hive have overrun Titan. I was wrong to bring us here…
Every Guardian lost under my command is my responsibility. What am I, if I am unable to bear that fact?
